What will you do?

• Thoroughly clean and maintain the production and packaging areas
• Ensure that the communal areas are kept clean and tidy
• Follow the applicable hygiene and safety regulations carefully
• Carry out your tasks independently and accurately
• Provide support in the packaging department when colleagues are absent or during particularly busy periods

The hiring company is one of the world's leading manufacturing partners. The organization operates a global network of manufacturing and business operations across multiple countries, serving both regional and international markets.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage overall IT operations, infrastructure, and end-user support services.
• Oversee ERP and related business systems, ensuring smooth operations and continuous improvement.
• Lead IT projects, including system implementations, upgrades, migrations, and digital initiatives.
• Drive cybersecurity, governance, compliance, and disaster recovery readiness.
• Manage cloud services, Microsoft 365 environment, and technology vendors.
• Control IT budgets, contracts, software licensing, and asset management.
• Collaborate with business teams and HQ IT to align technology solutions with business needs.
To apply online please click the 'Apply' button below. For a confidential discussion about this role please contact Gift Petto on  66 2 012 5067.

• Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field.
• Experience leading IT operations, infrastructure, and ERP environments.
• Strong knowledge of networks, servers, virtualization, cloud technologies, and cybersecurity.
• Proven track record in IT project delivery and digital transformation initiatives.
• Experience managing vendors, budgets, and stakeholder relationships.
• Good English communication skills; Korean language ability is a plus.

Our client is going through a large-scale IT transformation. They're looking for an experienced Solution Architect who loves both the big picture and the technical detail, and who wants real impact in a technology leadership role.
What you'll do

• Design solutions that matter. You'll own end-to-end architecture for key IT initiatives, making sure they're robust, secure and fit for purpose

• Be the bridge. You'll connect Enterprise Architecture with the delivery teams, turning strategy into solutions that actually get built

• Team up. You'll work hand in hand with business owners, domain architects and engineers to deliver high-quality results

• Shape the roadmap. You'll define target architectures and roadmaps for a core business domain, using your hands-on experience

• Build for reuse. You'll create solution patterns and building blocks that other teams can rely on

• Share what you know. You'll lead communities of practice, exchange lessons learned with fellow architects and help the architecture practice grow

• 10+ years in IT, with solid experience as a Solution Architect on large transformation programmes

• Strong architecture skills: event-driven and service-based architectures, MicroServices, RESTful APIs

• Agile and DevOps experience at scale, including CI/CD. SAFe knowledge is a nice bonus

• A Togaf certification, or a similar one

• Tech you've worked with: .NET, Angular, Azure, Kafka, SQL, BPM/low-code platforms, Mainframe backends and SaaS packages

• The ability to zoom in and out: you're as comfortable writing a strategy document as solving an implementation challenge

• A pragmatic mindset: you go for what works, not what looks perfect on paper

• Autonomy and sharp analytical skills: you break down complex problems across teams and locations and come up with actionable answers

• Strong communication skills: you can convince project teams and senior management alike

• A mentor's spirit: you enjoy helping newer architects grow

• Fluent English

 

Nice to have

• Experience in financial services and its regulatory environment

• Knowledge of capital markets

• Familiarity with frameworks like Open Agile Architecture

jobs.occupation: Cream Consulting by Audensiel - Business Analyst
jobs.description:
What is Cream all about ?

 

We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

The Cream recipe

- 1/3 Personal development - 1/3 Collective intelligence - 1/3 Intrapreneurship - Bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues :)
Your future projects

Like Morgane, Business Analyst at Cream, you work close to business & IT teams and work on applications. Your tasks will be :

• Communicate with the different stakeholders in order to understand their requirements

• Translate business requirements into detailed business specifications for IT

• Analyze the impact due to required evolutions

• Perform impact analysis of new processes and determine the gaps between as-is and to-be situations

• Design and document the to-be process

• Organize the Test strategy and follow up the testing

• Coordinate and communicate with the different stakeholders

• Change management and deployment

• Adapt yourself to the new environment of our clients

What do we expect from our consultant ?

• You have at least 2 years of experience in Business or Process analysis

• You can meet project deadlines and provide high-quality deliverables

• You are fluent in French and English, a good knowledge of Dutch is an asset

• An experience in project management methodologies (Prince 2, PMI, Agile...) and tools (Balsamiq, Clarity, Jira, Azure, Enterprise Architect...) could be a real asset

• A knowledge of Business Process Modeling (ARIS, Visio, Camounda, UML, ...)

We are seeking an experienced and commercially minded Partnerships, Engagement & Development Officer to help strengthen BSB's external profile, contribute to student enrolment growth and support the development of future fundraising and community engagement initiatives. 
  
Reporting to the Marketing & Admissions Director, you will build and manage strategic relationships with organisations, businesses, embassies, international networks and community groups that can help connect prospective families with BSB. You will also help develop partnership and fundraising opportunities that support the School's long-term objectives.
  Key Responsibilities  Partnership Development    
• Identify, develop and maintain strategic relationships with businesses, embassies, international organisations, relocation providers, chambers of commerce and community groups.  
• Build a strong network of external partners who can support student recruitment, community engagement and the School's wider strategic objectives.  
• Create and manage partnership initiatives that deliver mutual value and long-term engagement.   Business Development & Outreach    
• Proactively identify new opportunities to increase awareness of BSB and generate interest from prospective families and key stakeholders.  
• Develop outreach activities and engagement initiatives that strengthen BSB's visibility within the international community.  
• Represent BSB at networking events, conferences, community activities and professional forums.   Admissions & Enrolment Support    
• Work closely with Admissions and Marketing colleagues to develop referral channels and partnership opportunities that support enrolment growth.  
• Help identify and engage new audiences and communities that may be interested in BSB.  
• Monitor the effectiveness of outreach and partnership activities and make recommendations for continuous improvement.   Fundraising & Development    
• Support the development of sponsorship, fundraising and philanthropic initiatives that strengthen the School's long-term development goals.  
• Identify and cultivate relationships with potential sponsors, donors and supporters.  
• Assist in developing engagement opportunities that encourage long-term investment in the BSB community.   Stakeholder Engagement    
• Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, acting as an ambassador for BSB at all times.  
• Work collaboratively across departments to maximise partnership opportunities and ensure a joined-up approach to engagement activities.  
• Maintain regular contact with key partners and ensure relationships remain active and mutually beneficial.   Performance & Continuous Improvement    
• Maintain accurate records of partnership activity, stakeholder engagement and business development opportunities.  
• Monitor outcomes and trends, evaluating the impact of initiatives and identifying opportunities for growth.  
• Provide regular insights and recommendations that support future planning and decision-making. 
Essential    
• Demonstrable success in business development, partnership development, account management, fundraising or a related relationship-driven role.  
• Proven ability to develop new relationships and convert opportunities into measurable outcomes.  
• Experience identifying and pursuing new opportunities, rather than solely managing existing accounts.  
• Experience managing multiple opportunities and priorities simultaneously and delivering against agreed objectives.  
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data and insights to inform decisions and improve performance.  
• Experience forecasting outcomes, identifying risks and taking proactive action to maintain progress.  
• Strong stakeholder-management, networking, influencing and relationship-building skills.  
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.  
• Excellent organisational, communication and presentation skills.  
• Excellent spoken and written English.      
Desirable
    
• Experience working with international organisations, multinational companies, embassies, diplomatic communities, relocation organisations or professional networks.  
• An established professional network within Belgium and/or relevant international communities.  
• Experience in fundraising, sponsorship, philanthropy or corporate partnerships.  
• Experience within education, international education or another relationship-driven environment.  
• Experience supporting student recruitment, admissions, customer acquisition or business growth activities.  
• French and/or Dutch language skills.   Candidate Profile    
• Commercial focus: Understands how strong relationships translate into tangible outcomes and sustainable growth.  
• Business development instinct: Enjoys creating opportunities, opening doors and building new connections.  
• Relationship builder: Establishes credibility quickly and develops trusted relationships across cultures, sectors and levels of seniority.  
• Strategic thinker: Able to identify opportunities, assess priorities and focus effort where it will have the greatest impact.  
• Results-oriented: Takes ownership, follows through and delivers against agreed objectives.  
• Analytical: Uses evidence, insight and good judgement to inform decisions and recommend action.  
• Resilient and proactive: Maintains momentum, follows up consistently and remains focused on long-term goals.  
• Collaborative: Works effectively with colleagues across functions to achieve shared objectives.  
• Professional and discreet: Exercises sound judgement and represents BSB with credibility and integrity.  
• International mindset: Values diversity and thrives in an international and multilingual environment.   What Success Looks Like    
• Development of a strong portfolio of active strategic partnerships.  
• Increased awareness of BSB amongst key external audiences and communities.  
• A measurable contribution to enrolment growth through partnership and outreach activities.  
• Growth in fundraising, sponsorship or development opportunities.  
• Strong engagement and retention of key partners and stakeholders.  
• Effective identification and progression of new opportunities and networks.

jobs.occupation: Electric Pallet Truck (EPT) Orderpicker / Warehouse Operator - 2 Shifts | Evergem (Ghent region, ...
jobs.description:
As an essential link in our order fulfillment chain, your focus is safety, speed, and accuracy. Every day brings variety:
    
•   
Safely navigate the warehouse floor operating an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT) to pick, stage, and transfer orders.
    
•   
Execute precise loading and unloading procedures, ensuring all materials remain 100% damage-free.
    
•   
Follow structured warehouse safety protocols to stage, stack, and place incoming goods accurately.
    
•   
Support stock counting, inventory tracking, and swift shelf replenishment so goods are always ready to roll.
   

 
    
•   
Proven hands-on experience operating an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT), backed by a valid EPT certificate or license.
    
•   
Full availability and willingness to work in an alternating two-shift schedule (early and late shifts).
    
•   
Strong English communication skills to ensure seamless coordination and safety across the warehouse floor.
    
•   
Reliable personal transport (car, motorbike, or e-bike) to commute independently to the facility in Evergem.

Your responsibilities include:
  
Production & Planning
    
• Organize and coordinate the daily operations of the cutting, deboning, and packaging processes based on customer orders.  
• Monitor productivity, carcass yield, and production lead times, taking corrective action where necessary.  
• Coordinate production activities with sales and transport to ensure daily deliveries leave on time.   
 
  
People Management
    
• Lead, motivate, and coach a team of 15 employees, including butchers, meat cutters, packers, and drivers.  
• Prepare staff schedules and monitor attendance, leave, and training.  
• Participate in the recruitment, onboarding, and evaluation of new employees.   
 
  
Quality & Food Safety
    
• Work together with the quality department to ensure the site complies with IFS, ACS, and FASFC regulations.  
• Monitor hygiene, cold chain management, and traceability on the production floor and take action when deviations occur.  
• Assist in preparing for audits and inspections and follow up on corrective actions.   
 
  
Infrastructure, Maintenance & Safety
    
• Take responsibility for buildings, refrigeration systems, machinery, and production lines.  
• Coordinate maintenance and repairs with internal technicians and external partners.  
• Ensure workplace safety, employee well-being, and good housekeeping standards.   
 
  
Transport & Logistics
    
• Manage the company's fleet of refrigerated trucks and the drivers.  
• Organize daily route planning to ensure every delivery reaches the customer on time and in full.  
• Monitor cold chain compliance during transport and oversee fleet maintenance, inspections, and legal requirements.   
 
  
Monitoring & Continuous Improvement
    
• Monitor KPIs (yield, productivity, costs, complaints, and waste) and report to management. 
  
• Bachelor's degree level or equivalent through experience.  
• At least 5 years of experience in a management role within production, preferably in the meat or food industry.  
• Practical experience with food safety standards (IFS, HACCP, ACS, FASFC) and audit processes.  
• Hands-on leader: visible on the shop floor and capable of motivating a team of skilled professionals.  
• Stress-resistant and decisive: able to maintain oversight in a fast-paced production environment with demanding delivery schedules.  
• Structured, with a strong focus on numbers, processes, and continuous improvement.  
• Fluent in Dutch and English. Additional languages are considered an asset in our multilingual team.  
• Flexible: willing to start early when required to oversee production at the beginning of the shift. Production starts at 3:00 a.m.

jobs.occupation: Assistant (all genders) in our EU Representation in Brussels
jobs.description:
• Provide organisational and administrative support to the Brussels team, working closely with the Executive Management Assistant  
• Assist with planning business trips, including travel expense claims  
• Help plan and organise internal and external meetings and events  
• Handle professional correspondence with the member companies, political institutions, public authorities and other stakeholders, and assist with preparing and sending mail merges  
• Manage shared mailboxes and coordinate appointments, deadlines and outstanding tasks  
• Assist with preparing and updating documents, presentations and position papers, including final quality checks  
• Coordinate the monthly eu-flash newsletter and help maintain the website and other information materials  
• Coordinate with internal and external service providers (e.g. IT and suppliers), check invoices and prepare cost summaries  
• Assist with onboarding new employees and interns 
  
• Completed vocational training as a foreign-language secretary or a comparable qualification involving foreign languages, plus several years of experience in an assistant role, ideally in an association, a political institution or a similar environment  
• Professional, courteous communication skills, with the ability to adapt to different audiences  
• Native-level proficiency in German, fluency in English and a good command of French are required  
• Confident and proficient use of MS Office, particularly SharePoint, Teams, PowerPoint and Word  
• Strong organisational and planning skills, with sound judgement in setting priorities, managing deadlines and coordinating multiple tasks  
• An independent, structured approach to work, the ability to work as part of a team, a high level of commitment and dedication, and a strong service orientation

A packed schedule, a hundred things happening at once and always something that needs sorting out. Sound familiar?
  
Some people find that stressful. You actually thrive on it!
  
As Management & Personal Assistant, you'll become a trusted right hand to management, providing both professional and personal support.
  
But here's what really makes the difference: you don't just get things started, you make sure they're properly taken care of, right down to the smallest detail. 
  
You'll be trusted to take ownership, anticipate needs and find solutions independently, without constant reminders or follow-ups.
  
The goal? To give management the peace of mind that when something is in your hands, it's taken care of.
  
No two days are quite the same. And that's exactly what makes this role so interesting!
  
Your responsibilities cover two main areas.
  
Management Support – Making things happen behind the scenes
    
• You manage inboxes, calendars and daily communications, ensuring everything is followed up efficiently.  
• You organise and prepare meetings, appointments and discussions.  
• You gather information, bring structure and create clear, practical overviews.  
• You keep track of deadlines, action points and ongoing projects.  
• You provide administrative and organisational support across various management responsibilities, including sales and HR.  
• You liaise with colleagues, suppliers and external partners.  
• You assist with the practical organisation of business trips, trade fairs, reservations and events.  
• When management is away, you keep things moving. You follow up on important matters, handle what you can independently and provide a clear overview upon their return.   
Personal & Household Management – Making life easier!
  
Beyond business support, you'll also help keep the personal lives of the management team running smoothly.
  
This isn't a housekeeping position. It's about coordinating, organising and taking care of practical matters that make everyday life easier.
    
• You coordinate external household help and manage the related planning and communication.  
• You arrange home maintenance, repairs, deliveries and appointments.  
• You handle practical errands and purchases for both the company and private needs.  
• You manage orders, parcels, deliveries and returns.  
• You organise gifts, flowers and thoughtful gestures.  
• You research and coordinate private travel, appointments and reservations.  
• You take care of practical arrangements involving vehicles, servicing and other everyday matters.   
And sometimes, something unexpected simply needs sorting out.
  
No problem. You focus on solutions, not obstacles!

An impressive CV? Great! But for this position, who you are and how you work matter just as much as what you've already accomplished.
  
We're looking for someone who's naturally organised. Not because they've learned to be, but because it's simply part of who they are. Someone who notices the little things, thinks ahead and genuinely enjoys bringing order to a busy day.
  
Does this sound like you?
    
• Organisation is second nature to you. You love structure, have an exceptional eye for detail and never lose sight of the bigger picture.  
• You're always thinking a few steps ahead. You spot what needs doing, take initiative and don't wait for instructions.  
• You take real ownership. When something is entrusted to you, others can count on it being handled from start to finish, without having to double-check.  
• Discretion comes naturally. You're trustworthy, reliable and understand the importance of confidentiality when professional and personal matters overlap.  
• You're hands-on, flexible and solution-oriented. You switch easily between different responsibilities and stay calm when unexpected situations arise.  
• You're a confident communicator and digitally savvy. You communicate clearly, feel comfortable with digital tools and adapt easily to different situations.  
• You genuinely enjoy making life easier for others. Knowing that someone can stop worrying about something because you've taken care of it? That's what motivates you!   
What else do you bring?
    
• A bachelor's degree and ideally some initial experience in an administrative, organisational or support role.  
• Previous experience in a similar position is a definite advantage, but the right attitude, maturity and potential to grow into the role are just as valuable.  
• Fluency in Dutch and English, both written and spoken, ideally together with good written French.  
• A valid category B driving licence.   
And the right personal fit? That's just as important to us.
  
You feel at home in a dynamic, informal environment with a relatively young team. You're positive, engaged and bring a healthy dose of common sense.
  
Ultimately, we're looking for someone management can turn to and say: "Could you take care of this?" And know it's in good hands.
